data.title: Patch Notes — June 23, 2026
data.content:
Attention, Pilots! The following update for War Robots: Frontiers will be deployed after a short maintenance period on June 23, 2026.

New Content

  • New Event Pass: Ancient Relic
  • New War Robot: Relic Bulgasari
  • New Weapon: Relic Orkan

New Event Pass: Ancient Relic (June 23 – July 6)

Unlock the latest robot Relic Bulgasari, Stormpike weapons as well as various resources and new cosmetics!

New War Robot: Relic Bulgasari

A legendary classic reborn. Relic Bulgasari fights the frontline with an asymmetric shoulder shield, an extra light weapon slot, and a precise linear strike via its modified Arpeggio ability.

Starting June 23, Relic Bulgasari will be available through Daily Deals, direct offers and the new Event pass.

New Robot Weapon: Relic Orkan

Rocket launcher built for the Assault class. Optimized for heavier setups, it features faster reload times, higher projectile velocity, and a high-precision direct damage profile for sustained firefights.

Starting June 23, Relic Orkan will be available through Daily Deals and direct offers.

New Event

Intel and Salvage Discount Event (June 23 – 30)

This week, the Tortuga engineers invite Pilots to take a closer look at the following builds:

  • War Robot Modules: Bulwark, Ceres, Grim, Crix
  • Weapons: Bisector, Katzbalger, Stormpike, Thunder
  • Gear: Reflector, Ghost Turret, Fuel Burn, Minefield, Nanite Repair, Holofield
